title: The School Ghost
lines: Kids at school said a ghost lived there.
At night it made a long, sad sound.
The cook said it was just a machine.
But Meg and Mom went one dark night.
Meg saw a sign on a back door.
She gave it a tug. Green eyes shone!
It was a cat! No ghost at all.

questions.ask: What did the kids think was in the school?
questions.listenFor: A ghost. It is in the very first line.

questions.ask: What was really making the sound?
questions.listenFor: A cat, in back of the door with the sign on it. The cook had guessed wrong.

questions.ask: Why did Meg take Mom along with her?
questions.listenFor: Listen for the thinking, not the verdict - a dark school at night is not a place to go on your own.
